en: The postcard features a colored photograph of a harbor town taken from an elevated, wooded viewpoint. The image shows the harbor (hamnen) and the city of Sundsvall with tree-lined hills in the foreground and buildings and waterfront below. The reverse side contains handwritten text in Swedish, address lines, and printed Swedish words typical of early 20th-century postcards.
